description: D.G. Yasasiri v. National Development Bank of Sri Lanka and Another D.G. Yasasiri v. National Development Bank of Sri Lanka and Another View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: D.G. Yasasiri v. National Development Bank of Sri Lanka and Another D.G. Yasasiri v. National Development Bank of Sri Lanka and Another View More
keywords: Leave to Appeal to set aside Additional District Judge’s order and have the Petitioner be granted unconditional leave to appear and show cause against decree nisi in action filed under the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act No 2 of 1990 (as amended by Act No 9 of 1994). Held - Affidavit filed by Petitioner failed requirements in Section 6(2) of the Act. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act No 2 of 1990 (as amended)
